name: catalog/error_logs
description: Any ERROR or worse log line from a catalog service, except the ones the chunk and batch alerts already cover and the Cloud Run request log (covered by the worker errors alert).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND severity>=ERROR AND NOT jsonPayload.message="chunk failed" AND NOT jsonPayload.message="batch failed" AND NOT jsonPayload.message=~"^batch swept" AND NOT jsonPayload.message="catalog_qa: quality check unavailable" AND NOT jsonPayload.message="matting_breaker" AND NOT jsonPayload.message="spend cap hit" AND NOT logName="projects/image-links-agent/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests"
